# PC-AUDIT01 implementation and prospective verification

Delivery: [PR206](https://github.com/binance-hackathon-glasswing/binance-hackathon/pull/206)
targets the canonical integration branch and is draft pending independent review
and the explicitly listed private/affordability/release/host gates.

Implementer: Keith/Codex. Canonical baseline: `697ff3a`. PR204 audit/history
is merged intact into `codex/pr204-repairs`; immutable trial artifacts are not edited.

Before execution, commit and push tests and then each application revision.
Portable red/green acceptance: earlier normalized inputs equal stored HTTP inputs
after multiple tool calls; rejected length replies remain errors and retain exact
validated usage; 120s is timely at 180s/120s and late at 60s/90s; missing/invalid
bounds remain unknown. Extend coverage to nested mutations, truncation, tool and
provider errors, abandoned/deferred/parallel I/O, all usage outcomes, stage-cap
validation/wire identity/reservations, strict citation failures and cause metrics.

Proposed offline candidate (not an installed/adopted configuration): new v4
routing pins routine/OpenAI output at 4096 and each high-effort external reviewer
at 16000. Existing v1-v3 specs and prompt bytes retain their original meaning.
Models/efforts and durable ledger/accounting policy stay unchanged. The increased
external ceiling addresses reasoning exhausting 4096 before JSON; it does not
prove completion or affordability. A new pinned reviewer addendum instructs exact
copying of verified claimable objects and exact Unicode span/source checks using
the existing strict contract, with no citation-handle resolver or permissive repair.

Pass criteria: new regressions and relevant intelligence/deferred/budget/runtime
preparation/release tests pass; Linux/PostgreSQL qualification and applicable
systemd/sandbox checks are reported distinctly from macOS checks. No blind golden
regeneration. Manifest/bundle checks cover new configuration/prompt identities.

Private-corpus replay (11 truncated replies, six invalid reviewer stages), measured
provider completion/affordability, independent labels, new exact-release review and
host acceptance remain separate until actually run. Preserve frozen M5 counts;
diagnostics may recover known rejected usage but cannot revise the frozen verdict.
No paid inference, installation, restart, wallet operations or deployment is authorized.
